About

I’ve spent 6+ years building backend services, primarily in Go. I’ve worked on REST and gRPC APIs, WebSocket messaging, and background jobs. On a real-time messaging product, I investigated delivery issues and how read status gets out of sync across devices.

I’ve managed Kubernetes workloads on AWS and Alibaba Cloud and helped move manual Docker releases to CI/CD. I use metrics and distributed traces to investigate production issues, and I work with teammates on code reviews, mentoring, and breaking down tasks.

Engineering Case Study

Automating deployments for a real-time chat app

Problem. Releases depended on developers logging into servers and starting application containers with docker run.

My contribution. I helped the team move deployments into CI/CD. On the Kubernetes side, I maintained deployment manifests and troubleshot application workloads.

Outcome. Once the automated workflow was in place, developers could release the app without starting containers manually on servers.
